newsitem.title: UK: Glynwed, sector rises as stg retreats.
newsitem.headline: Glynwed, sector rises as stg retreats.

text.p: Shares in UK engineering group Glynwed Plc resumed its recovery on Tuesday, as sterling continued to retreat, dealers said.
The shares also were buoyed by positive comments from Credit Lyonnais Laing analyst Daniel Bevan, who recommended the stock, saying it was oversold.
The shares, bouncing back from a four-year low set last week, were up 12p to 217 by 0813 GMT as sterling held below the 3.0 mark level.
Dealers said sentiment for Glynwed was improving ahead of the group's interim results, due on August 12.
Other UK engineering shares also were marked higher on the back on sterling's depreciation.
Among them, shares in TI Group Plc and Smiths Industries Plc each added 24-1/2p to 538-1/2 and 780 respectively. Shares in Siebe Plc advanced 23-1/2p to 1067. Shares in GKN Plc jumped 38p to 1028.
"All the engineers are up in the sky on the back of sterling's drop," one marketmaker said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
